To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the numerical simulation and analysis can be used to predict the behavior of soil nailed wall supporting structure and pile anchor supporting structures for deep foundation excavations.
soil nailed wall and the pile anchor supporting structure have different force action characteristics in the case of deep foundation excavation.
soil nailed wall and piled anchor are two different supporting methods,which have different deformation mechanism and stress characteristics.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the characteristics of stress field,displacements,and bottom uplift of deep foundation pit excavation with soil nailed wall and with pile anchor.
the deformation characteristics and mechanism of deep foundation pit with two different supporting methods,which provides reference for deep foundation pit supporting design.

the deformation mechanism of deep excavation with different supportings and the characteristics of force action,which can provide reference for the selection of supporting structure in deep excavation engineering.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

soil nailed wall is more suitable for deep foundation excavation with large excavation area and large excavation depth, and pile anchor is more suitable for foundation pit with high water table and high groundwater level.

the deformation mechanism and characteristics of foundation pit with soil nailed wall and with pile anchor are different,so the two different supporting means should not be used at the same time in engineering.
the two supporting means have different effects on the deformation of foundation pit and the stress field of soil mass.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the supporting effect of pile anchor is better than soil nailed wall in the case of deep foundation excavation,which can reduce the stress and displacement of foundation pit effectively and improve the stability of excavation face.
the two different supporting methods have their own characteristics,and the supporting method should be chosen according to actual engineering situation.

the soil nailed wall supporting structure was more suitable for deep foundation excavation with the following characteristics:the soil was loose,soft,and with high water content;the foundation excavation was shallow,with small excavation depth and large excavation width;the excavation soil was not easy to slide and the soil was stable;and the soil was not easy for water to seep through and the groundwater level was not high
The main takeaway from our work is that
the soil nailed wall supporting structure can reduce horizontal displacement and stress concentration,which is conducive to the stability and safety of deep foundation excavation.
the numerical simulation of soil nailed wall is more accurate than that of pile anchor supporting.

the soil nail wall can effectively control the deformation of the foundation pit and the bottom uplift, and the deformation of the pile anchor supporting structure is relatively larger, but the deformation of the two supporting structures is basically the same.
